title: Flow Control: Steering Vision-Language-Action Models with Simple Real-Time Inputs
abstract: arXiv:2606.10180v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce flow control of vision-language-action (VLA) models, a simple and effective way to steer VLA actions in real time through generic inputs, such as a keyboard. This method can be used out-of-the-box and does not require retraining or fine-tuning VLAs. It enables relatively crude user inputs to steer a VLA to align with user intent. Flow control writes the user input into the initial condition of the VLA's flow matching action expert. Because the flow is deterministic, integration retains information about the user input while moving it toward the action distribution learned during training, so that the generated actions reflect the user's intent (high fidelity) and stay close to the VLA's own unsteered actions (high conformity). We demonstrate that flow control has many desirable properties: (1) flow control accurately and responsively steers robot actions with user inputs, (2) it is robust to suboptimal user inputs,

translated_title: 流控制：通过简单的实时输入引导视觉-语言-动作模型
translated_abstract: 我们提出了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的流控制，这是一种通过键盘等通用输入实时引导VLA动作的简单而有效的方法。该方法可以开箱即用，无需对VLA进行重新训练或微调。它使相对粗糙的用户输入能够引导VLA与用户意图保持一致。流控制将用户输入写入VLA流匹配动作专家的初始条件中。由于流是确定性的，积分过程在保留用户输入信息的同时，将其向训练期间学习到的动作分布推进，从而生成的动作既反映用户意图（高保真度），又与VLA自身未引导的动作保持接近（高一致性）。我们证明流控制具有许多理想的特性：(1) 流控制能够准确、灵敏地通过用户输入引导机器人动作，(2) 它对次优的用户输入具有鲁棒性。
tldr: 该论文提出“流控制”方法，无需重训练即可通过键盘等简单输入实时引导视觉-语言-动作模型，通过将用户输入写入流匹配的初始条件，使生成的动作既忠实于用户意图又与模型自身行为保持一致。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces flow control, a training-free method that steers vision-language-action models in real time via simple inputs like keyboards by injecting user input into the flow matching initial condition, achieving both high fidelity to user intent and high conformity to the model's own behavior.
